modalities.evidence: MRI scans from 9 healthy adult participants

output.population: 9 healthy adult participants, aged 22-55 years, each scanned at both imaging sites
output.summary: Traveling-subject MRI dataset for harmonizing autism neuroimaging studies: healthy adults scanned at two imaging sites with diffusion-weighted, T1-weighted and T2-weighted protocols, including ABCD- and HCP-matching diffusion sequences.
